description: Full-size glass-fibre replica, not a real airframe: it stood as the RAF Alconbury gate guardian in 527th Aggressor Squadron markings from 1981 until removed on 1 April 2026, when the USAF donated it to the RAF Sculthorpe Heritage Centre. Serial not applicable as the replica carries only aggressor markings.
aliases: F-5E; F5E; Tiger II; Tiger 2; F5
